confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded from aggregator estimates (Expatistan, Whereandwhen, Lifeindexed) with small or mixed samples, dated between 2025 and 2026, and some pages were generic templates. Expat-area and downtown-club prices run well above typical local venues, so beer, coffee, cocktail and wine were set between those tiers. Cocktail and wine are weaker: cocktail was set at roughly twice the beer anchor and wine by the glass was set from the bottle price with a restaurant markup, since no direct restaurant glass price was found. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, with no accommodation search or live listing check, so they are the least certain (low confidence). The FX value is the RBA's 16 October 2026 USD observation, which was reported in search results and should be checked against the RBA table if the publication timing matters.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Drink and restaurant anchors are anchored to Quito's own aggregated price observations, with Latin American mid-sized capital pricing as a regional sanity check. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a mid-sized Andean capital with a historic-centre tourism market.
